name: Still Waters: In Memoriam
source:
"You clean out your deceased great grandmother's beach house, and all the memories contained within." Made for Pastel Jam 2018.

[From [url=https://lazerfly.itch.io/still-waters-in-memoriam] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你清理已故曾祖母的海滨别墅，以及其中承载的所有回忆。”本作是为2018年Pastel游戏创作活动制作的作品。

（来源：[url=https://lazerfly.itch.io/still-waters-in-memoriam]itch.io[/url]）
